newsitem.title: FINLAND: Neste trading still has big downside - paper.
newsitem.headline: Neste trading still has big downside - paper.

text.p: Finnish oil and energy group Neste Oy's oil trading positions still have significant downside and losses may rise to 460 million markka, daily Helsingin Sanomat reported on Wednesday.
The group announced on July 26 that it had a 285 million markka sales margin deficit in trading. Helsingin Sanomat said the deficit would widen if oil prices continued to rise.
"The top figure mentioned at the supervisory board's meeting on Tuesday was 460 million markka," the paper said, quoting unnamed sources.
